data.name: Versatile Performance (String Instruments)
data.description: You can use your bonus in the Perform (String Instruments) skill in place of your bonus in the Bluff or Diplomacy skills. When substituting in this way, you use your total Perform (String Instruments) skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of your Bluff or Diplomacy skill bonus, whether or not you have ranks in that skill or if it is a class skill.
